Only the three named artifacts were written. Mutation anchors M8/M9/M10 each occur exactly once; the matrix's expected-line arguments were compared against the live source lines and match byte for byte. No control bytes in any artifact.

**Four things a reviewer should weigh, stated plainly**

1. **The self-test has not been run.** This seat is forbidden from executing the adjudicator, so its `--self-test` fixtures — 41 guard corruptions plus the marker-mapping and statistics checks — are statically reviewed only. First execution belongs to launch prep.
2. **`$T1_VITEST_FLAGS` is asserted, not verified.** I could not confirm the flag spelling against the pinned Vitest 4.1.10, so §2 of the matrix adds a preflight that captures `vitest --help` into a receipt and requires every flag to appear there before any cell runs, rather than substituting silently at run time.
3. **The 0% occupancy baseline is deliberately partial.** A full `fill(0)` reset would touch all 17,301,504 expiry doubles and flatten the whole sweep to zero by construction. The harness instead zeroes counts/heads/saturation in full (which makes 0% occupancy exact and provable) and leaves the expiry array as the ten registrations left it. That scope is recorded in the report as `occupancyAlgorithm`, so the baseline is auditable rather than implicit.
4. **I ran a few non-`--check` node invocations while authoring the files** — rewriting the ANSI regex line after literal ESC bytes landed in it, and counting anchor occurrences. These were file authoring and verification; nothing from the experiment was executed.
